hero_kpi_rationale_en: Primary indicator of the company's financial performance, reflecting 2% growth and increased demand for HIV therapies and liver products

ai_positioning.summary_en: Gilead explicitly mentions the adoption and scaling of artificial intelligence as a strategic priority in its 2025 10-K report. AI is among the five strategic priorities aimed at transforming the company's operations.
evidence_en: Strategic priorities refreshed in late 2025 include: adopt and scale artificial intelligence to transform how we work

risks.title: Increased competition in cell therapies
risks.summary_en: Cell therapy product sales expected to decrease due to competitive headwinds in 2026
risks.score_rationale_en: The company faces ongoing competitive headwinds in cell therapy products (Tecartus, Yescarta), with expected sales decreases in 2026 due to competitive pressures (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Regulatory changes affecting drug pricing
risks.summary_en: U.S. policy-related developments are expected to negatively impact 2026 revenues
risks.score_rationale_en: Various policy-related developments in the U.S. are expected to offset product sales growth in 2026, with significant impact on pricing and market access (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Dependence on key products
risks.summary_en: High revenue concentration in HIV products, particularly Biktarvy and Descovy
risks.score_rationale_en: HIV product sales represent significant revenue concentration (20.8 billion in 2025), creating vulnerability to competitive and regulatory changes (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Clinical trial risks and delays
risks.summary_en: Clinical trial failures and FDA holds on investigational compounds
risks.score_rationale_en: Recent clinical trial setbacks include FDA clinical hold on GS-1720/GS-4182 trials and discontinuation of STAR-221 study in gastric cancer (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Patent litigation and LOE risk
risks.summary_en: Ongoing patent litigation risks related to key products
risks.score_rationale_en: Biktarvy patent settlements have extended LOE to April 2036, but continued patent challenges remain in the pipeline (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Foreign exchange volatility
risks.summary_en: Foreign exchange exposure across 35+ countries of operation
risks.score_rationale_en: International operations expose Gilead to currency fluctuations affecting reported revenues and financial results (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Pipeline execution and product development
risks.summary_en: Success depends on advancing 50+ clinical-stage programs to market
risks.score_rationale_en: Company targets 10+ transformative therapies by 2030; failure to execute clinical programs and secure approvals threatens long-term growth (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: The nature and timing of loss of exclusivity for these products depends on a multitude of factors, and loss of exclusivity may be earlier under certain circumstances
